3. Close and reopen browser

Authentication & Login.steps:
1. Enter valid email
2. Enter incorrect password
3. Click Login

Authentication & Login.steps:
1. Enter non-existent email
2. Enter any password

Authentication & Login.name: Blank email and password submission
Authentication & Login.steps:
1. Leave both fields blank
2. Click Login

Authentication & Login.steps:
1. Enter valid email
2. Enter only whitespace in password

Authentication & Login.name: Expired password reset link
Authentication & Login.preconditions: Valid email, reset link older than expiry
Authentication & Login.expected: Error: "Link expired"; prompt to request new reset

Authentication & Login.name: Account lockout after N failed attempts
Authentication & Login.expected: Account temporarily locked; lockout message shown

Authentication & Login.name: SQL injection in login fields
Authentication & Login.steps:
1. Enter ' OR '1'='1 in email field
2. Enter any password
3. Submit
Authentication & Login.expected: Login fails; no DB error exposed; no unauthorized access

Authentication & Login.name: XSS in login fields
Authentication & Login.expected: Input sanitized; no script executed; reflected safely

Authentication & Login.name: Brute force protection
Authentication & Login.steps: 1. Send 100 rapid login attempts via script
Authentication & Login.expected: Rate limiting or CAPTCHA triggered; IPs blocked

Authentication & Login.name: JWT token tampering
Authentication & Login.steps:
1. Decode JWT
2. Modify payload (e.g. role: admin)
3. Re-encode and send
Authentication & Login.expected: Request rejected with 401; tampered token not accepted

Authentication & Login.name: Password transmitted in plaintext
Authentication & Login.steps:
1. Login with valid creds
2. Inspect network requests
Authentication & Login.expected: Password not visible in request body in plaintext; HTTPS enforced

Authentication & Login.name: Session fixation attack
Authentication & Login.preconditions: Attacker sets session ID before login
Authentication & Login.expected: New session ID generated post-login; old ID invalidated

Authentication & Login.name: CSRF on login/logout
Authentication & Login.steps:
1. Create external page with hidden form
2. Submit cross-origin request
Authentication & Login.expected: CSRF token validated; cross-origin form requests rejected
